subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should Discord add a default-off `autoMentionReply` policy that visibly mentions the original guild message author on replies, or should native replies plus explicit/configured mentions remain the supported notification model?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix changes Discord notification semantics and adds stable-channel config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent product policy.

options.title: Approve Opt-In Auto-Mention
options.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with original-author prefixing, duplicate-mention and broadcast safety checks, docs, focused tests, and live guild proof.

options.title: Keep Current Notification Model
options.body: Leave native Discord replies and explicit or configured alias mentions as the supported behavior, and document that OpenClaw does not synthesize reply-author mentions.

options.title: Require Live Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a live multi-bot Discord transcript proving the notification gap before accepting new config surface.

recommendation.title: Approve Opt-In Auto-Mention
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with original-author prefixing, duplicate-mention and broadcast safety checks, docs, focused tests, and live guild proof.
